lines: 3 When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill outside his university , he immediately telephoned the police and informed them that two students dressed up as workmen were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill . telephone the police 报警（打电话给警察） inform sb. of sth . 通知某人某事 dress (sb.) up as ... 把(某人)打扮成…… tear up sth. 挖凿、撕开 As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously . as soon as ... 一...就... hang up 挂电话 over adv.从这边到哪边 If a window has a view over an area of land or water, you can see the land or water through the window. 从一边到另一边 * be to do （fml.）的四种用法 Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested. — Francis Bacon He added that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people . add v.补充说 play a joke / trick on sb. 开某人的玩笑/捉弄某人 all sorts / kinds / types of sth. 各种各样的… Both the police and the workmen were grateful to the student for this piece of advance information . be thankful / grateful / obliged / indebted to sb. for sth. 为某事对某人表示感谢/感激
